items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I thank God that there was a guy like Schillinger who came along and invented this method so that a guy like Gershwin could come along and use his method to produce Porgy and Bess.

ctx.x: that, it was called from an opera, but of course most people in those days thought opera was Italian and richly endowed by the Metropolitan and such, and I'm sure they didn't think of it as an opera.

As I was saying, methods-- I can't get along with methods--not that I can't get along, I can't use them to write with. I can't get a method to come out of me. Nevertheless, I thank God that there was a guy like Schillinger who came along and invented this method so that a guy like Gershwin could come along and use his method to produce Porgy and Bess.
I have speculated-- surely not at length, but if Gershwin had lived which musical direction he would have gone--have you ever speculated, can you imagine what he might be doing musically?
